title: Bay Area Youth Conservation
description: Youth-led climate education, workshops, and volunteer opportunities in San Leandro, San Lorenzo, and the East Bay.

hero.eyebrow: Youth-led conservation in the Bay Area
hero.heading: Helping local students turn climate care into community action.
hero.body: Bay Area Youth Conservation brings young people together through climate education, hands-on volunteer opportunities, and community workshops in the San Leandro and San Lorenzo area.

whoWeAre.heading: A teen-founded environmental organization.
whoWeAre.body: We are a teen-founded environmental organization passionate about one goal: making the environment more sustainable. We aim to spread awareness about climate issues through community education and inspire youth to get involved by making it easy and accessible through volunteering opportunities.

goal.body: Our ultimate goal is to show the youth that change is possible. We encourage and support any kinds of interest in environmental justice. Through small actions and steps, we can have a cleaner neighborhood and a more sustainable and ecologically educated community.

cards.heading: Workshops
cards.body: We host community workshops every two months at San Leandro Library, with youth-friendly topics that make local environmental action easier to understand.

cards.heading: Volunteer Opportunities
cards.body: We connect students with conservation-minded service opportunities that support neighborhoods, outdoor spaces, and community awareness.

cards.heading: Education Posts
cards.body: Through short, accessible posts, we share climate facts, sustainability tips, and conservation ideas students can use in everyday life.

cards.heading: Collaborations
cards.body: We work with schools, clubs, libraries, and local groups to bring youth conservation projects and education to more people.

ask.heading: Not sure where you fit in? Just ask.
ask.body: Whether you want to attend a workshop, volunteer, or bring BAYC to your school or community space, send us a note and we will get back to you.
